title: Letter 1
text: Hello love, I wish I had started this when you first left but I got this idea right now so here we are. I love you so deeply and hope you're having so much fun in texas.

title: Letter 2
text: Hello love, HAPPY 6 MONTH MEETIVERSARY. Who knew that day would be the best domino effect of all time. What attracted me the most to you that day was how outgoing and passionate you were in our conversation. I went home and layed in my bed smiling for like 2 hours and you've made me feel like that everyday since. I love you rif!

title: Letter 3
text: Hello love, HAPPY GIRLFRIENDS DAY RAHHHHH. It pained me to pretend like I forgot whilst I was being too lazy to open my laptop. Anyways I love you and thank you for making me so happy to have a girlfriend on girlfriends day. Wish I could be celebrating you in person. Love and miss you so deeply rif

title: Letter 4
text: Hello love, Sorry this took longer than past days, the couch rot got me. I hope you had so much fun in Texas, I'm so glad you are back in the bay so we can talk more I miss you sm. PS: we survived our first week, only 7 more to go!
